label: Ceramic Bas-relief
intent: Collectible physical depth and a bridge toward product or spatial concepts
path_treatment: Carve the visual path as a glazed recessed channel or raised flowing ridge.
form_treatment: Model primary forms as asymmetric raised clay planes with hand-tooled marks.
space_treatment: Use relief depth, raking light, and an irregular plaque boundary instead of photographic perspective.
composition: Complete physical plaque visible with one depth hierarchy and calm surrounding space.
